input: We're using MIPI CSI-2 v4.2 with a new event-based vision sensor (EVS) that outputs sparse pixel events rather than full frames. The V4L2 driver receives the data but our ISP pipeline expects raster-scan frames. MIPI CSI-2 v4.2 added standardized ESP (Event-based Sensor Protocol) support. How should we configure the V4L2 media controller pipeline for event-based sensors, and what changes are needed in the ISP DMA-BUF allocation for sparse event data vs full frames?
